title: Microsoft 365 Copilot app: redesigned navigation pane with longer chat history and quick create for Notebooks and agents
summary: The briefing matches the launched roadmap change and distinguishes it from the related release note. The Notebook and agent controls, including the preview Graph applyOnce operations and their permissions and scope restrictions, are supported by Microsoft documentation.

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 Copilot app has a simpler, reorganised navigation pane.
claims.quote: The Microsoft 365 Copilot app now has a simpler, cleaner navigation.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The Notebook policy is reached in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center through Customization > Policy Management > policy configuration > Choose the scope > Configure Settings > Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks.
claims.quote: Select Customization from the left pane. ... Select Policy Management. ... Create a new policy configuration or edit an existing one. ... From the Choose the scope dropdown list ... In Configure Settings ... Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks

claims.claim: POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors can set the Notebook policy using preview applyOnce mode and the documented copilotpagesnotebooks baseline resource.
claims.quote: POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors ... applies a desired-state baseline once in applyOnce mode.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Why it matters; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks policy defaults to Enabled.
claims.quote: Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks creation | Cloud Policy: Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks | Enabled

claims.claim: Not configured makes Copilot Pages and Notebooks creation and integration available, like Enabled.
claims.quote: Not configured: Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks creation and integration are available to the users.

claims.claim: The Cloud Policy UI supports All users or a selected group.
claims.quote: From the Choose the scope dropdown list, choose either All users or select the group for which you want to apply the policy.

claims.claim: Disabling Notebook creation through Cloud Policy hides the Notebooks module in the Copilot app.
claims.quote: When creation is disabled, users are unable to create new Copilot Pages or Notebooks. The Pages module is visible in the Microsoft Copilot app, but the Notebooks module is hidden

claims.claim: Users whose OneDrive creation is disabled cannot create Copilot Pages or Notebooks regardless of this policy.
claims.quote: If your organization disabled the creation of OneDrive, regardless of the setting noted here, these people in your organization can't create Copilot Pages or Copilot Notebooks.

claims.claim: Agent and plugin user access is configured at Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > Settings > User access.
claims.quote: Open the Microsoft 365 admin center in your browser. ... Select Agents > Settings > User access to manage your organization's agents and plugins.

claims.claim: POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors can set agent user access using preview applyOnce mode and the documented useraccess baseline resource.
claims.quote: POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors ... applies a desired-state baseline once in applyOnce mode.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Why it matters; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Agent User access defaults to All users.

claims.quote: all users in the organization can access agents and plugins, subject to the existing app policies and user assignments.

claims.claim: User access offers No users to prevent organization members from accessing agents and plugins.
claims.quote: No users - This option means that no users in the organization can access agents and plugins.

claims.claim: User access offers Specific users or groups to select who can access agents and plugins.
claims.quote: Specific users or groups - This option lets you select specific users or groups in your organization to have access to agents and plugins.

claims.where: controls[1].governs; controls[1].note; Risk assessment; Governance controls table
claims.claim: User access controls access to and installation of agents and plugins, not Agent Builder creation independently.
claims.quote: Choose All users, No users, or Specific users or groups to control who can access and install agents and plugins. This setting controls agent and plugin access, not Agent Builder creation independently.

claims.claim: Features available in the Copilot app depend on licensing and tenant settings for agents and Notebooks.
claims.quote: Copilot capabilities and the controls that are available to manage them vary by license and service. ... Pages and Notebooks | Use the applicable Cloud Policy settings to manage whether users can create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks.

claims.claim: AI Administrator is an appropriate role for managing Copilot settings in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: To manage Copilot settings in the Microsoft 365 admin center, use an appropriate admin role, such as AI Administrator.

claims.claim: Cloud Policy changes take up to 90 minutes to be reflected when policy configurations already existed.
claims.quote: If there were existing policy configurations before the change, the change takes up to 90 minutes to be reflected.

claims.claim: Cloud Policy changes take up to 24 hours to be reflected when no policy configurations existed.
claims.quote: If there were no policy configurations before the change, the change takes up to 24 hours to be reflected.

claims.claim: The beta copilotPolicySetting API updates tenant-level Copilot policy settings.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version are subject to change. ... only tenant-level policies are supported. ... Update | copilotPolicySetting | Update the properties of a copilotPolicySetting object.

claims.claim: The copilotPolicySetting supported settings list covers Chat pinning, open-content access, image generation, web search and Admin Copilot, not Notebooks or agent access.
claims.quote: Only these values are accepted ... microsoft.copilot.copilotchatpinning ... microsoft.copilot.blockaccesstoopenfiles ... microsoft.copilot.imagegeneration ... microsoft.copilot.allowwebsearch ... microsoft.copilot.allowinadmincenters

claims.claim: A configurationMonitor runs periodically in monitorOnly mode to detect drift.
claims.quote: runs periodically in the background at a scheduled frequency to detect configuration drift in monitorOnly mode

claims.claim: An applyOnce configurationMonitor applies a desired-state baseline once instead of merely monitoring.
claims.quote: applies a desired-state baseline once in applyOnce mode. ... An active applyOnce monitor runs in the background on behalf of the signed-in administrator and then becomes inactive.

claims.claim: Remediation and applyOnce for the listed Copilot and Agent resources are preview capabilities through Microsoft Graph beta.
claims.quote: These capabilities are available in preview through Microsoft Graph beta. ... microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks ... microsoft.agent.useraccess

claims.claim: The microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks baseline resource sets value to 0 to disable or 1 to enable Pages and Notebooks creation and viewing.
claims.quote: "resourceType": "microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks" ... value | Write | String | Allows or prevents creating and viewing Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks ... 0 disables the setting; 1 enables the setting.

claims.claim: TCM Notebook policy automation supports tenant-level policies only.
claims.quote: TCM supports these settings only in tenant-level policies in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.

claims.claim: Notebook policy automation fails if that setting is configured in any group-level policy.
claims.quote: ensure that the target setting isn't configured in any group-level policy in that admin center. If it is, monitoring, snapshots, remediation, and applyOnce fail for that resource.

claims.claim: Creating an applyOnce monitor requires the calling app's delegated ConfigurationMonitoring.ReadWrite.All permission.
claims.quote: Creating an applyOnce monitor supports delegated permissions only. In addition to the calling app's delegated ConfigurationMonitoring.ReadWrite.All permission

claims.claim: For applyOnce on these Notebook and agent resources, the TCM service principal needs delegated CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite permission.
claims.quote: microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks | CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite | AI Administrator ... microsoft.agent.useraccess | CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite | AI Administrator

claims.claim: AI Administrator is the required least-privileged signed-in user role for applyOnce on the listed Notebook and agent resources.
claims.quote: Assign the listed administrative role to the signed-in user, not to the service principal. ... microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks ... AI Administrator ... microsoft.agent.useraccess ... AI Administrator
